Cookie Policy

Effective April 2026

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember information about you and your preferences, making your experience better on repeat visits.

There are two main types of cookies: session cookies, which expire when you close your browser, and persistent cookies, which remain on your device for a longer period. Cookies can be set by the website you're visiting (first-party cookies) or by third-party services that the site uses.

Cookies We Use

We use cookies to provide essential functionality, understand how visitors use our site, and improve our service. Here's what we use them for:

Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the core functionality of our website. They enable basic functions like page navigation and access to secure areas. Without these cookies, our site cannot function properly.

  • Language preference: We use a functional cookie (md_locale) to remember whether you chose to view the site in English or Spanish, so your choice persists as you navigate between pages.
  • Session Management: We use session cookies to keep you logged in and maintain the state of your visit.
  • Security: Cookies help us prevent fraud and protect the security of our site and your information.

Analytics — No Cookies Used

We use Plausible Analytics, a privacy-friendly analytics service, to understand how visitors interact with our website in aggregate. Plausible is cookieless — it does not set any cookies and does not collect personal data or cross-site identifiers. No data is shared with third parties or used for advertising.

Plausible reports basic, anonymous information such as the page you visited, the referring site, the device type, and the country of origin. You can review their data policy at plausible.io/data-policy.

Third-Party Cookies

We use select third-party services that may set their own cookies:

  • Calendly: If you use our scheduling feature, Calendly may set cookies to manage your booking experience and remember your preferences.

We choose these vendors carefully, but we're not responsible for their cookie policies. You can review their privacy and cookie practices on their respective websites.

How to Control Cookies

You have control over cookie settings in your browser. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when a cookie is being set. You can also delete cookies that have already been set.

Here are links to cookie control settings for major browsers:

  • Google Chrome
  • Apple Safari
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Microsoft Edge

Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website. Some features may not work as intended if cookies are blocked.

Impact of Disabling Cookies

If you choose to disable cookies, you should be aware of the following potential impacts:

  • You may not be able to use all features of our website.
  • Your experience may be less personalized, and you may see repeated content or have to re-enter information.
  • Your language preference won't be remembered between visits; you'll have to re-choose English or Spanish each session.
  • Analytics on this site do not use cookies, so disabling cookies has no effect on analytics.
  • Third-party services like scheduling tools may not function properly.

Essential cookies cannot be disabled, as they're required for the website to function.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of material changes by updating the "Effective" date at the top of this policy.

Your continued use of our website after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated Cookie Policy.

Contact Information

If you have questions about our use of cookies or this policy, please contact us:

Email: don@muntin.digital

Website: muntin.digital

We're happy to answer your questions and address any concerns about how we use cookies.
